entities.name: SI message acquisition
entities.description: Procedure for UE to acquire System Information messages by monitoring PDCCH during SI-window using SI-RNTI.

entities.name: SI-window
entities.description: Time window during which UE monitors PDCCH for SI message acquisition. Length determined by si-WindowLength.

entities.name: SI-RNTI
entities.description: Radio Network Temporary Identifier used for scheduling System Information messages.

entities.name: PDCCH monitoring occasion
entities.description: Time occasions when UE monitors PDCCH for SI message acquisition, determined by searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation.

entities.name: searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation
entities.description: Parameter indicating search space for PDCCH monitoring occasions for SI messages. If zero, uses same as SIB1.

entities.name: schedulingInfoList
entities.description: List in SIB1 configuring SI messages and their scheduling parameters.

entities.name: schedulingInfoList2
entities.description: Alternative list for configuring SI messages in SIB1.

entities.name: posSchedulingInfoList
entities.description: List in posSI-SchedulingInfo in SIB1 for positioning-related SI messages.

entities.name: SSB to PDCCH monitoring occasion mapping
entities.description: Mapping where [xN+K]th PDCCH monitoring occasion corresponds to Kth transmitted SSB.

entities.name: UE SSB selection implementation
entities.description: UE implementation selects which SSB to use for SI message reception.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE may stop PDCCH monitoring during SI window after acquiring requested SIBs.

relations.description: SI acquisition procedure involves monitoring PDCCH occasions.
Procedure uses SI-RNTI to receive PDCCH scheduling information.
PDCCH monitoring occasions are determined by searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation parameter.
PDCCH monitoring occasions are mapped to transmitted SSBs using [xN+K] formula.
SI acquisition occurs during SI-window period.
SSB to PDCCH mapping enables UE implementation to select SSB for reception.
In RRC_CONNECTED state, UE may stop PDCCH monitoring during SI window after SIB acquisition.
